session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend From The Open, Late Failed Breakout'. Buy the close bull trend from the open (gap bar 3) drove a small pullback bull trend most of the day; midday sideways 20-gap bar buy signal wedge bull flag at EMA, trend resumption up in the afternoon, then a late failed trend resumption up micro double top (12:50 high 4465) sold the close back to 4440.
